Definition: Glory — literally weightiness and substance; God's radiant majesty and honour, and the dignity He shares with His image-bearers.
BiblicalUsage: God's kabod filled the tabernacle so Moses could not enter, and Isaiah heard the whole earth is full of it. To give God glory is to recognise the weight of who He truly is.
TheologicalSignificance: Kabod anchors our worth and our worship: the King of glory is not far away — He fills His creation and invites His people to reflect His glory.
